Exercise: CABLE ROPE FACE PULL at pulled position. Standing upright in small staggered stance facing one cable tower with pulley at eye height. One two-ended rope handle connected centrally to taut cable, two CLOSED neutral hands grasp ends at either side of face near temples. Elbows bent about90degrees, flared outward at shoulder height, wrists aligned, rope visibly forks from central junction IN FRONT of face toward hands. Cable runs from junction straight toward tower pulley, never through head. Rear-side three-quarter view showing both hands, face-side rope, shoulder blades and full tower. Coral posterior deltoids and mid-back muscle bellies only. No barbell.
